. OPTIONS ON CORE/BUTTONS layout: {"type":"flex","justifyContent":"left|center|right|space-between"}; "orientation":"vertical" stacks the buttons. Gap: style.spacing.blockGap (no inline style). align "wide" | "full" -> alignwide / alignfull. OPTIONS ON CORE/BUTTON (see core/button for markup) Style variation: "className":"is-style-outline" in the comment and on the outer div; fill is the default look and needs no class. Colours, border radius, padding, shadow, font size and text alignment go on the inner , not on the div. Width: style.dimensions.width, written in the comment only. PITFALLS A button with no text renders nothing on the front. Never write is-layout-* or wp-container-* classes: WordPress adds them when it renders.
